summary: Kit: stat table on the level-up dialogs from kit pieces
author: pm
body:
The level-up and majestic stat dialogs still draw the old stat-table sprite (InterfaceNdGame4 frame 4 at 16,100) over the kit panel. It has its own lighter cloth, so it shows as a box and runs about 4 px past the panel's right edge (measured from a screenshot, build/screenshots/hh0066_b6_level_up.jpg). Replacing it needs kit value boxes and +/- button art.

**Done when:** the stat rows draw from kit pieces with no sprite box, and the buttons and values work as before.

Source: HH-0066 batch 6, 2026-11-24.
